problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 9 delivery trucks across 9 distribution centers. Each truck must follow a predetermined route through the centers, where each stop is represented as (Center, Unloading time), specifying the distribution center where the truck must stop and the time required to unload its cargo. The sequence of stops must be followed in the exact order given.

Truck routes:
* Truck 1 follows: (Center 4, 6) → (Center 2, 1) → (Center 7, 1) → (Center 6, 8) → (Center 1, 5) → (Center 9, 4) → (Center 8, 3) → (Center 3, 8) → (Center 5, 2)
* Truck 2 follows: (Center 7, 9) → (Center 1, 10) → (Center 3, 5) → (Center 8, 2) → (Center 2, 6) → (Center 6, 8) → (Center 4, 10) → (Center 5, 6) → (Center 9, 5)
* Truck 3 follows: (Center 6, 6) → (Center 4, 1) → (Center 1, 9) → (Center 9, 4) → (Center 5, 2) → (Center 2, 9) → (Center 8, 4) → (Center 7, 1) → (Center 3, 9)
* Truck 4 follows: (Center 6, 3) → (Center 3, 8) → (Center 7, 5) → (Center 9, 3) → (Center 2, 1) → (Center 4, 6) → (Center 8, 5) → (Center 5, 6) → (Center 1, 5)
* Truck 5 follows: (Center 4, 1) → (Center 7, 1) → (Center 1, 9) → (Center 8, 3) → (Center 6, 10) → (Center 2, 3) → (Center 3, 2) → (Center 9, 3) → (Center 5, 3)
* Truck 6 follows: (Center 9, 4) → (Center 3, 10) → (Center 4, 1) → (Center 7, 6) → (Center 1, 6) → (Center 8, 6) → (Center 2, 2) → (Center 6, 10) → (Center 5, 6)
* Truck 7 follows: (Center 6, 10) → (Center 2, 3) → (Center 4, 9) → (Center 8, 2) → (Center 3, 6) → (Center 5, 10) → (Center 1, 10) → (Center 7, 9) → (Center 9, 10)
* Truck 8 follows: (Center 2, 7) → (Center 3, 6) → (Center 8, 2) → (Center 7, 6) → (Center 4, 3) → (Center 6, 5) → (Center 9, 3) → (Center 1, 6) → (Center 5, 8)
* Truck 9 follows: (Center 2, 4) → (Center 6, 3) → (Center 7, 10) → (Center 3, 8) → (Center 8, 10) → (Center 5, 7) → (Center 1, 10) → (Center 9, 4) → (Center 4, 1)

Once a truck begins unloading at a center, the process must continue without interruption until completion, and each distribution center can only accommodate one truck at a time for unloading. The objective is to schedule the unloading sequences at all distribution centers so that the total completion time for all trucks is minimized.
